$comment: Sprint 1 hardening - custom WAF rules for ReconIQ. Apply via the Cloudflare rulesets API on the http_request_firewall_custom phase. Rules are evaluated top-to-bottom; the first match wins. Order is critical: ALLOW > CHALLENGE > BLOCK. Edit and re-apply with scripts/apply-waf-rules.sh. Rate-limit rules (stripe webhook, AI endpoint) live in a separate rate-limit ruleset applied by scripts/apply-waf-ratelimit-rules.sh.

rules.description: P-M-12: Block SCIM POSTs from non-allowlisted origins (defense vs spoofed SCIM). IdPs (Okta/Entra/Google) and FVI origins are allowlisted via the `not any(...)` clause.
rules.expression: http.request.method eq "POST" and starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/api/public/scim/v2/") and not any(http.request.headers["origin"][*] in {"https://*.okta.com" "https://*.okta-emea.com" "https://*.oktapreview.com" "https://login.microsoftonline.com" "https://graph.microsoft.com" "https://*.google.com" "https://app-fvi.reconiq.example" "https://staging-fvi.reconiq.example"})

rules.description: P-A-04: JS challenge on /api/public/oauth/token from non-allowlisted origins (credential stuffing defense)
rules.expression: http.request.method eq "POST" and http.request.uri.path eq "/api/public/oauth/token" and not any(http.request.headers["origin"][*] in {"https://app-fvi.reconiq.example" "https://staging-fvi.reconiq.example" "https://reconiq.example" "https://www.reconiq.example" "https://support-fvi.reconiq.example" "https://admin.reconiq.example"})

rules.description: P-M-11: Block SQL injection patterns in query string (defense-in-depth on top of parameterized queries). Free-tier-compatible: case-sensitive substring match; covers the common attack probes.
rules.expression: (http.request.uri.query contains "union select" or http.request.uri.query contains "UNION SELECT" or http.request.uri.query contains "drop table" or http.request.uri.query contains "DROP TABLE" or http.request.uri.query contains "or 1=1" or http.request.uri.query contains "OR 1=1" or http.request.uri.query contains ";--")

rules.description: P-M-09: Bot Fight Mode for /contact and /book-demo POSTs (lead-gen spam protection)
GEO BLOCKLIST PLACEHOLDER - admin-toggled geographic blocklist (currently disabled). To enable: replace ip.geoip.country list with ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes and set enabled to true.
